subject: How do I debug browser reloading that disconnects the server

messages.author: 244f5e4abbc229bf
messages.subject: How do I debug browser reloading that disconnects the server
parts:
Hi,

I have a shiny app that I've inherited. If I fire it up with `runApp` it loads and works fine. If I refresh the browser, it disconnects the server (R unblocks). No error messages are printed to the console. How do I debug this? I'd really like to be able to refresh the browser to see changes as I update the app.

Jason
